blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Simon Fraser University Area. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Simon Fraser University Area, Burnaby: 91 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 6 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Simon Fraser University Area fell from 94 in June to 91 in September (−3.2%), and 30 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.8% of Burnaby’s 1,333 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Simon Fraser University Area?
Simon Fraser University Area also had 5 houses listed and 0 sold in September, against 91 condos and townhomes listed. The Simon Fraser University Area houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Simon Fraser University Area?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 91 condos and townhomes listed in Simon Fraser University Area. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Simon Fraser University Area a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Simon Fraser University Area had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser University Area from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 30 condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser University Area over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
